description: Change an Artifact you own or edit. Pass content to publish a new Version of the page at the same URL (the whole document, not a diff; earlier Versions stay in the history). Pass title, description, icon, or icon_image to change those. Any combination in one call. With content the call waits for the new Version to be live before returning. The new Version keeps the base Version's capabilities and state rules unless you pass capabilities or state.

capabilities.description: What the page may do at run time. state.read and state.write give it JSON documents at window.bisque.state (get, patch, list, subscribe); viewer.identity tells it who is viewing (window.bisque.viewer); events.emit lets it record typed Events. Omit for a page that only shows things.

content.description: The complete new document, same type as before.

icon_image.description: The page's own icon: the favicon in the browser tab and the icon a phone puts on its Home Screen. A data URL: an SVG (data:image/svg+xml,<svg …>) or a base64 PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF, at most 512 KB, cropped to a square. An SVG must be self-contained (no links to other files, fonts, or stylesheets); draw shapes rather than text. Without one the page shows the Bisque icon. null goes back to the Bisque icon.

state.description: Who may read and write which paths of the page's data, by the minimum role: viewer (can open), contributor (a data grant, separate from editing the page), owner. Absent means: everyone who can open reads, contributors and the owner write. Example poll: [{path:'votes',read:'viewer',write:'owner'},{path:'votes/{self}',write:'viewer'}].

path.description: A slash path the rule covers, and everything below it; '' is the root. A trailing {self} names each person's own document under the prefix.

name: update_artifact

audience_mode.description: Who can open it: owner, users, org, or public.

icon_image_url.description: The page icon set with icon_image; null for the Bisque icon.

publication_status.description: ready means the URL serves this content now. queued or processing means it is still being prepared; call get_artifact to check. failed carries publication_error.

published_version_id.description: The Version viewers see; null until a publication is ready.

title: Update an Artifact
